name: Life On Other Planets
overview: Scripture affirms that God created the heavens and the earth with intentionality and purpose, establishing the earth specifically to be inhabited (Genesis 1:1; Isaiah 45:18). While the heavens and celestial bodies are the Lord's creation (Psalms 8:3; Psalms 115:16), the earth is uniquely given to humanity. The gathering of God's elect from all parts of heaven and earth (Mark 13:27) and Christ's intimate knowledge of His people (John 10:14) emphasize God's sovereign care and redemptive plan centered on human beings in this world.
